Name: Central Station - Anthro Patch
Author: Nanopede
Description:
I'm unfortunately a furry, so I can't play without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]. But mods have so many humans! This aims to help a little with that. :] Changes the ticket vendor, pianist, mannequin and two other vendors from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url] into furries.

Currently, the only mod with an anthro edit which uses the station is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37867]my anthro patch[/url] of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url], so I'd recommend pairing this with those unless you'd only like vanilla locations. But I'd like to change that! (and maybe this can help you change that..!)

Has optional support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31510]Central Station - Recolour Compatibility[/url], in that the ticket vendor can be the right tones to match Earthy recolour, VPR and Starblue. Currently this has to be manually changed in the config menu, but I'd like to look into if it's possible to detect it automatically like I think I've seen others use.

Not compatible with They Deserve It To- they'll have human portraits.

There are two NPCs which can show up as human - I believe they are from vanilla and haven't been modified yet by ACC. After mulling on it, I didn't want this mod to conflict with them if ACC updates them. That being said, let me know if you think the decision is silly and I can look into it.

I don't believe any other edits should be necessary from my testing, but let me know if I need to fix anything. This is my second mod and I'm
still trying to figure out what i'm doing, hahaha. That being said, if I disappear off the face of the earth and it needs to be changed feel free to fix it and post that fix. Similarly, feel free to edit the sprites however you want, as long as you are respectful to the original vision and license of Central Station.

Downloads.Description: I am a dummy and accidentally broke the json when putting update keys in. If you downloaded this before and it didn't work, it should work now.
